hook_text: DON'T SAVE IT FOR THE DOORKNOB
hook_line: The biggest mistake patients make? Saving their worst symptom for the very end. (And if a symptom feels severe or sudden, like chest pain, trouble breathing, or sudden weakness, don't wait for an appointment at all. Call 911 or go to the ER.)

beats.narration: Before your visit, write down everything, then pick your top three concerns.
beats.label: Pick Top Three

beats.narration: Say your biggest worry first, right at the start, not as you're leaving.
beats.label: Say It First

beats.narration: Bring your medication list, insurance card, and records from other doctors.
beats.label: Bring These Items

beats.narration: Describe symptoms clearly: when it started, how often, and how bad, one to ten.
beats.label: Describe Clearly

beats.narration: Use Ask Me Three: what's my main problem, what do I need to do, and why does it matter.
beats.label: Ask Me Three

beats.narration: Before leaving, repeat the plan back in your own words to catch mistakes, and remember, if new or worsening symptoms show up later, don't wait for your next appointment to get help.
beats.label: Teach It Back
